title: Embedded Comparator Configuration
statement: Let $k,l$ be positive natural numbers, let $H$ be a type, choose a state map $e:\text{Fin}(3)\times\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\to H$, Boolean words $w,s,u,v$, a phase $q\in\text{Fin}(3)$, and a bit $b$. Embedding the comparator configuration on input $w$, with words $u,v$, both work heads at the origin, and state $(q,b)$ into the two designated host slots, using the prescribed background layout on all other tapes, then applying $e$ to its state, gives the canonical host configuration with state $e(q)$ and layout consisting of candidate $s$, word $u$ in the first bank's designated tape, and word $v$ in the second bank's designated tape.
replaced:
Relocating a comparator configuration at zero displacement through the
comparator-pair selection yields the host's canonical configuration whose
layout holds the two whole compared words together with the unchanged
candidate, every module scratch tape being blank.
